lastTask: Implement Byte 17b-a setup plumbing and safe keyword matching

projectState.summary: Byte 17b-a is implemented on codex/byte-17b-a. It tightens SongGoal keyword matching to token/phrase matching, adds a false-positive regression for repair/crunch, makes GrowWorldState hold a mutable active tonal context, lets transport read active tonal context and tempo through handlers, and routes root-name/display formatting through active context. Behavior should remain 90 BPM / C mixolydian by default; SongGoal still does not apply setup, refresh lookahead, or persist song.goal_set. Validation so far: npm run build and npm run smoke (35/35) are green.
